messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute speed after first 10 seconds given distance 120 m starting from rest. We can assume constant acceleration? The problem likely expects constant acceleration. Use kinematics: s = ut + 0.5 a t^2. u=0, t=10, s=120 => 0.5 a *100 =120 => a=120*2/100=240/100=2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v = u + a t = 0 + 2.4*10 =24 m/s. So first part speed 24 m/s.

Second part: after reaching this speed, car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to final speed equal to twice the initial speed? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Means starting at 12 m/s? But earlier we had 24 m/s. Maybe misinterpretation: In second stage, car accelerates from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed (the initial speed of second stage?). Actually "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" means final speed is twice the speed computed in first part. So final speed = 2 * 24 = 48 m/s. Starting speed of second stage is 12 m/s? But that contradicts continuity: after first stage, speed is 24 m/s. So maybe they mean second stage starts at 12 m/s? That would mean car decelerated? Unlikely. Maybe they mean second stage starts at 12 m/s (maybe the car had slowed down?) But the problem says "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍". Could be miswritten: maybe they mean from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed of second stage? But then final speed would be 24 m/s. But they also say final speed is twice the speed from first part. That would be 48 m/s. Contradiction.

Let's parse: "在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。" So after reaching 24 m/s, car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed. But initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s? That would mean car slowed from 24 to 12? Not plausible. Maybe they mean the car accelerates from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed of the second stage (i.e., 24 m/s). That would give final speed 24 m/s, but they also say final speed is twice the speed from first part (48 m/s). So maybe they mean initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s, final speed is twice that (24 m/s). But that contradicts earlier statement that final speed is twice the speed from first part. So maybe the problem has inconsistent data. We need to choose interpretation.

Better: The second stage: car accelerates for 5 seconds, starting from 12 m/s, ending at a speed that is twice the initial speed of the second stage (so 24 m/s). But also they say final speed is twice the speed from first part (48 m/s). That can't both hold. So maybe they mean initial speed of second stage is 12 m/s, final speed is twice the speed from first part (48 m/s). That would be 12 to 48 m/s over 5 seconds. That seems plausible: initial speed 12 m/s, final speed 48 m/s. But why mention "twice the initial speed"? Might be miswritten. Let's assume second stage: start at 12 m/s, end at 48 m/s over 5 seconds. Then acceleration a = (v - u)/t = (48-12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2.

But we need to compute acceleration using function. We can call kinematics_calculate_acceleration with initial_speed=12, final_speed=48, time=5. That will give acceleration. Let's do that.
